R13 adaptation notes (not source code):

1. Separate semantic relationships from final transforms: object dimensions, room polygon, openings and relationship constraints form solver input.
2. Preserve doors, windows and open-wall regions in the initial occupied state instead of treating the room bounding box as entirely usable.
3. Use a bounded deterministic search and return explicit failure when constraints cannot be satisfied.
4. Convert a successful solution into placements only after the constraint phase completes.

R13 stops before the search phase: Spatial Intent records the relationships while Environment Facts records the measured feasible domain. No Holodeck DFS/MILP, language-model prompt, Python package or AI2-THOR dependency is copied.
